overview: 本期共收录 8 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、劳动经济学（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、机器学习为主。来源分布：NBER（5 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（1 篇）。其中 5 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Strengthening Support Vector Machine Capability through Harris Hawks Optimization for Arabic Text Categorization
papers.abstract: The automated categorization of Arabic text remains a persistently difficult problem, largely because the language combines a productive root-and-pattern morphology, pervasive orthographic variation, and a scarcity of large, carefully annotated corpora—factors that together inflate the feature space and obscure the signal available to a learner. Within this setting, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) continues to serve as a strong discriminative baseline, yet its effectiveness hinges critically on how well its penalty term, kernel family, and kernel coefficient are configured, and on the dimensionality of the representation it must operate over. This study introduces a hybrid framework, termed SVM-HHO, in which Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO), a swarm-intelligence metaheuristic modelled on the cooperative besiege-and-pounce behavior of Harris' hawks—is entrusted with a single, unified search that simultaneously calibrates the SVM hyperparameters and isolates a compact, highly discriminative subset of Term Frequency–Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) features. The framework was assessed on a balanced, six-domain corpus of 6,000 Modern Standard Arabic news articles spanning Sports, Politics, Economy, Health, Technology, and Culture. Under this evaluation, SVM-HHO attained an accuracy of 99.5% together with precision, recall, and F1-score of 99.4%, surpassing by clear margins the untuned baselines examined—standard SVM (92.3%), Random Forest (94.2%), K-Nearest Neighbors (90.5%), and Naïve Bayes (88.3%)—while its accuracy also stands favourably beside a previously published SVM-PSO model (99.2% accuracy) reported on a related multi-domain Arabic corpus. Taken together, these findings indicate that the adaptive interplay between exploration and exploitation that characterizes HHO yields a particularly well-matched joint configuration of parameters and features, producing an accurate yet computationally frugal classifier for Arabic Natural Language Processing.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】阿拉伯文本的自动分类一直是一个难以解决的问题，主要原因在于该语言具有丰富的词形变化规律、普遍存在的拼写差异，以及缺乏大规模、经过精心标注的语料库。这些因素共同导致了特征空间的膨胀，使得学习者难以从原始数据中提取有用的信息。在这种背景下，支持向量机（SVM）仍然是一个有效的分类工具，但其性能高度依赖于惩罚项、核函数及其参数的配置方式，以及所处理数据的维度。本研究提出了一种混合框架SVM-HHO，该框架结合了基于哈里斯鹰群合作捕猎行为的群体智能元启发式算法Harris Hawks Optimization（HHO），通过单一的优化过程同时调整SVM的超参数，并筛选出具有高区分能力的词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）特征子集。该框架在包含体育、政治、经济、健康、技术和文化六个领域的6000篇现代标准阿拉伯语新闻文章的语料库上进行了测试，结果显示SVM-HHO的准确率达到99.5%，精确度、召回率和F1分数均为99.4%，显著优于未经优化的基准模型（标准SVM为92.3%、随机森林为94.2%、K近邻算法为90.5%、朴素贝叶斯为88.3%）。此外，其准确率也与之前在类似多领域阿拉伯语语料...。研究方法：模型校准、随机森林、优化方法。

papers.title: EVALUASI MODEL MACHINE LEARNING, DEEP LEARNING, DAN TRANSFORMER UNTUK ANALISIS SENTIMEN ULASAN SPKLU PADA PLN MOBILE DENGAN PENANGANAN KETIDAKSEIMBANGAN KELAS
papers.venue: IJIS - Indonesian Journal On Information System
papers.abstract: Fitur EV Charging/SPKLU pada aplikasi PLN Mobile mendukung layanan pengisian daya kendaraan listrik, tetapi banyaknya ulasan pengguna menyulitkan identifikasi sentimen secara manual. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis sentimen ulasan pengguna terkait fitur EV Charging/SPKLU dan membandingkan kinerja tujuh algoritma klasifikasi. Data diperoleh dari Google Play Store, kemudian melalui tahap text preprocessing dan pelabelan sentimen berdasarkan rating sebagai weak label. Algoritma yang digunakan meliputi Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM), dan DistilBERT, yang dikelompokkan menjadi Machine Learning, Deep Learning, dan Transformer. Untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas, diterapkan pembobotan kelas atau class weighting yang disesuaikan dengan karakteristik masing-masing algoritma pada data latih. Evaluasi dilakukan menggunakan Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Macro F1-Score, dan confusion matrix. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa MLP memperoleh Macro F1-Score tertinggi pada data validasi sebesar 67,80% sehingga dipilih untuk pengujian akhir. Pada 286 data uji, MLP menghasilkan Accuracy sebesar 89,16% dan Macro F1-Score sebesar 59,42%, yang menunjukkan kinerja klasifikasi keseluruhan yang tinggi dengan performa yang belum merata pada setiap kelas sentimen.Kata Kunci: Analisis Sentimen, SPKLU, PLN Mobile, Imbalanced Learning, DistilBERT
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：EVALUASI MODEL MACHINE LEARNING, DEEP LEARNING, DAN TRANSFORMER UNTUK ANALISIS SENTIMEN ULASAN SPKLU PADA PLN MOBILE DENGAN PENANGANAN KETIDAKSEIMBANGAN KELAS。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Computer science、Artificial intelligence、Mathematics」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。研究方法：回归分析、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、Transformer 模型。

papers.title: Zakat-Waqf Integration Model for Social Protection: Normative Policy Analysis of Islamic Philanthropy in Indonesia
papers.venue: ITQAN: Journal of Islamic Economics, Management, and Finance
papers.abstract: Indonesia faces significant challenges in providing sustainable and inclusive social protection instruments. According to Statistics Indonesia, 9.03% of the population remains below the poverty line, while economic inequality is reflected in a Gini ratio of 0.379. At the same time, the potential of Islamic philanthropy has not been optimally utilized due to institutional and structural limitations. Indonesia’s zakat potential is estimated at IDR 327 trillion annually, yet only around IDR 31.7 trillion (9.7%) is collected, while waqf assets are valued at approximately IDR 2,033 trillion but remain limited in impact and largely sectoral. This condition indicates a significant mismatch between the potential and the actual contribution of zakat and waqf to socio-economic development and social protection in Indonesia. This study departs from the premise that integrating zakat and waqf could strengthen both short-term financing capacity and long-term sustainability in social protection systems. However, existing academic studies remain limited and fragmented, often separating the redistributive function of zakat from the productive and asset-based nature of waqf, without integrating them into a unified social protection policy framework. This research employs a qualitative literature review of Islamic economic scholarship, national regulations, and comparative practices in other Muslim-majority countries. The study highlights the urgency of developing an integrative zakat waqf model as an innovative instrument to support poverty alleviation in Indonesia. By bridging the gap between philanthropic potential and policy design, this research contributes to contemporary Islamic economic discourse while offering a conceptual foundation for strengthening sustainable and inclusive social protection policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】印度尼西亚在提供可持续和包容性的社会保护机制方面面临着重大挑战。根据印度尼西亚统计局的数据，仍有9.03%的人口生活在贫困线以下，经济不平等现象体现在基尼系数为0.379。与此同时，由于制度和结构上的限制，伊斯兰慈善事业的潜力尚未得到充分利用。印度尼西亚的扎卡特（zakat）潜力估计每年可达327万亿印尼盾，但实际上仅征收了约31.7万亿印尼盾（占9.7%）；而瓦克夫（waqf）资产的价值约为2,033万亿印尼盾，但其影响力仍然有限，且主要集中在特定领域。这一情况表明，扎卡特和瓦克夫在促进社会经济发展和社会保护方面的潜力与其实际贡献之间存在显著差距。本研究基于这样一个前提：将扎卡特和瓦克夫结合起来，可以增强社会保护系统的短期融资能力和长期可持续性。然而，现有的学术研究较为有限且分散，往往将扎卡特的再分配功能与瓦克夫的生产性和资产基础特性割裂开来，未能将两者纳入统一的社会保护政策框架中。本研究通过对伊斯兰经济学术文献、国家法规以及其他穆斯林国家的实践进行定性分析，强调了开发一种综合性的扎卡特-瓦克夫模式的紧迫性，以此作为支持印度尼西亚减贫的创新工具。通过弥合慈善潜力与政策设计之间的...。

papers.title: An LLM Workflow That Reproduces, Improves, and Extends Published Economics Research
papers.abstract: We introduce an open-source workflow that enables an LLM to reproduce, improve, and extend an economics article using the article’s published replication package. First, the workflow attempts to reproduce the original calculations, checks for discrepancies with published findings, and performs automated sensitivity analysis. Across 4,452 published replication packages for five economics journals, the workflow flags discrepancies in 3,460 articles or their appendices. Second, the workflow improves the original calculations by using a different implementation or algorithm. In 496 articles, the workflow is able to reduce a calculation’s computation time, at similar or greater accuracy, by more than a factor of 10. Third, the workflow extends the original analysis. In 923 articles, the workflow develops an extension that does not appear in the original article and that is aligned with the original article’s goals and assumptions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们介绍了一种开源工作流程，该流程能够利用经济学文章发布的复制包（replication package），帮助大型语言模型（LLM）复现、改进并扩展这些文章的研究内容。首先，该流程尝试复现原始计算结果，检查与已发表研究结果的差异，并进行自动化敏感性分析。在五大经济学期刊发布的4,452个复制包中，该流程共发现了3,460篇文章或其附录中的计算错误。其次，该流程通过采用不同的实现方式或算法来改进原始计算结果；在496篇文章中，该流程成功将计算时间缩短了10倍以上，同时保持或提高了计算精度。第三，该流程对原始分析内容进行了扩展；在923篇文章中，该流程提出了新的分析方法，这些新方法并未出现在原始文章中，但与原始文章的目标和假设保持一致。。

papers.title: (How) Do We Teach Emotions?
papers.abstract: Emotional intelligence constitutes a key component of human capital, shaped partially by educational materials. Using machine learning and generative AI tools, we examine emotional content in public-school textbooks and children’s literature. A stark mismatch emerges: text exposes children to a broad emotional range, but images overwhelmingly depict happiness and calm, regardless of emotions described in text on the same page. Nearly half of pages show zero overlap between the emotions described in text and those shown in images. This pattern persists across time, contexts, and identities. Household purchases and library inventories suggest content may be endogenously shaped by consumer demand favoring “positive” cover imagery, implying market forces narrow the emotional landscape children encounter.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】情商是人类资本的重要组成部分，其形成在一定程度上受到教育材料的影响。我们利用机器学习和生成式人工智能工具，分析了公立学校教科书及儿童文学作品中的情感元素。研究发现存在显著矛盾：虽然文本内容涵盖了丰富的情感表达，但图片主要呈现的是幸福与平静的情绪，这与文本中描述的情绪完全不符。近一半的页面中，文本所描述的情绪与图片所展现的情绪毫无关联。这种现象在时间、情境及不同群体中均普遍存在。家庭购买行为和图书馆藏书情况表明，内容的选择可能受到消费者偏好的影响，即倾向于选择带有“积极”主题的封面图片；这意味着市场力量在一定程度上限制了儿童接触到的情感表达范围。。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Price Setting During a Currency Changeover
papers.abstract: We use the euro cash changeover, a large-scale and purely nominal reform that requires all firms to redenominate posted prices, to distinguish among theories of price rigidity. We develop a nonstationary menu-cost model in which firms anticipate the changeover date and may combine currency adoption with real price adjustment. The announcement makes the firm’s inaction region time-varying, a singular control problem with a moving boundary for which closed-form characterizations are rarely available. We solve this problem analytically by perturbation, recovering the whole path of the boundary, the date at which firms begin adopting the new currency, and the implied pricing moments. The model predicts that, as the changeover approaches, firms adjust more frequently but by smaller amounts, compressing the distribution of price changes. We test these predictions using historical CPI micro data from Austria, Finland, Greece, and Slovakia, a UK benchmark, and daily price data from the recent changeovers in Croatia and Bulgaria. Across changeovers, adjustment frequency rises while the size and dispersion of price changes fall. The model adds a single parameter to the standard menu-cost setup, the cost of pricing in the wrong currency. Calibrating it to the observed rise in adjustment frequency, the model reproduces the decline in the size of price changes and its subsequent recovery, neither of which is targeted. The evidence supports state-dependent price-setting models over models in which nominal redenomination leaves real pricing behavior unchanged.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们利用欧元现金兑换这一大规模且纯粹名义上的改革（该改革要求所有企业重新标价）来区分不同关于价格粘性的理论。我们构建了一个非平稳的菜单成本模型，在该模型中，企业能够预见到兑换日期，并可能将货币的采用与实际价格调整相结合。这一公告使得企业的“不作为区域”随时间发生变化，从而形成了一个具有移动边界的奇异控制问题，而这类问题通常难以用封闭形式进行解析。我们通过微扰方法对这一问题进行了分析，成功确定了边界的完整变化路径、企业开始采用新货币的日期以及相关的定价特征。模型预测：随着兑换日期的临近，企业调整价格的频率会增加，但每次调整的幅度会减小，从而导致价格变动分布的集中。我们使用来自奥地利、芬兰、希腊和斯洛伐克的历史CPI微观数据，以及克罗地亚和保加利亚近期货币兑换期间的每日价格数据来验证这些预测。结果显示，在所有货币兑换案例中，价格调整的频率均有所上升，而价格变动的幅度和离散度则有所下降。该模型在标准菜单成本框架中增加了一个参数——即使用错误货币进行定价的成本。通过将该参数校准到实际观察到的价格调整频率上升趋势，模型成功再现了价格变动幅度的下降及其后续的恢复过程，而这些现象并非模型预设的...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Here, There, and Everywhere: Remote Work’s Impact on Employment in the UK
papers.abstract: Remote work is often touted as a way for disabled and older workers to remain in the labour market. Post-Covid, the incidence of remote work has increased in the UK. Following Bloom et al. (2026), we test the effects of remote work on employment for these two groups using the pandemic’s increase in work from home rates as a quasi-experiment. We compare occupations with high growth in work from home (WFH) to those with lower growth in work from home, with growth rates measured among the non-disabled or younger. We then instrument using pre-pandemic remote work scores from Dingle and Neiman (2020). We find significant evidence that rising WFH increases employment of disabled and older workers in the UK. We additionally find decreases in commute time and wages for both groups, but no effect on hours worked.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：远程工作率的上升如何影响英国残障人士和老年工人的就业状况？

🔬 研究方法：利用疫情导致的工作远程化率增加作为准实验，比较远程工作增长高的职业与增长低的职业，并采用Dingle和Neiman（2020）的疫情前远程工作评分作为工具变量。

📊 核心发现：研究发现远程工作率的上升显著增加了英国残障人士和老年工人的就业率，同时减少了这两类群体的通勤时间和工资，但对工作时长无显著影响。

💡 应用价值：为政策制定者提供了实证证据，表明远程工作是保留残障人士和老年工人进入劳动力市场的有效途径。

papers.title: Impact of Adults’ College Completion on their Parents’ Mortality: Evidence from the 1993 Korean Higher Education Reform
papers.abstract: A large literature examines the economic and health returns to college education. We extend this literature by studying the upward intergenerational effects of children’s education on parental mortality. We exploit Korea’s 1993 Higher Education Reform, which we estimate raised college completion by 13 percentage points among eldest children in the 1974–1983 birth cohorts relative to the prior 10-year cohort. Using data from the Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging, reduced-form estimates indicate a 27% (s.e.=10%) reduction in mortality among parents whose oldest child was in the reform-affected cohort. Because the reform affected college completion but not other education levels or quality, we use it as an instrumental variable (IV) for child college completion. IV estimates indicate a 20% (s.e.=7%) reduction in parental mortality for children induced to complete college by the reform. These parents received greater financial support and contact from their children and had lower smoking and higher physical activity, although these mechanisms explain only a small share of the mortality benefit. Effects were larger for parents of daughters in reduced-form analyses, although IV estimates did not differ significantly by child gender. Future research should further investigate the mechanisms through which children’s college education affects parental mortality.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大量文献研究了大学教育对经济和健康的影响。我们通过研究子女教育对父母死亡率的影响，进一步拓展了这一研究领域。我们利用了韩国1993年的高等教育改革这一政策，据估计，该改革使得1974–1983年出生群体的长子群体中大学毕业率比前一个十年群体提高了13个百分点。通过韩国老龄化纵向研究（Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging）的数据，我们发现：在子女属于受改革影响群体的父母中，死亡率降低了27%（标准误=10%）。由于该改革仅影响了大学毕业率，而没有影响其他教育水平或质量，因此我们将其作为子女完成大学教育的工具变量（Instrumental Variable, IV）。工具变量估计结果显示，由于改革而完成大学教育的子女，其父母的死亡率降低了20%（标准误=7%）。这些父母从子女那里获得了更多的经济支持与关爱，同时他们的吸烟率更低、身体活动量更高；不过这些因素仅能解释部分死亡率降低的原因。在回归分析中，对于女儿的父亲来说，这种效应更为显著，尽管工具变量估计结果在不同性别子女之间并无显著差异。未来的研究应进一步探讨子女大学教育对父母死亡率影响的机制。。研究方法：工具变量。
